subject: Not quite there...
author: senocular
body: I definitely need to work on my stunt runs.  I've been mostly putting them off figuring I should just get good at it at some point and run through all the challenges at once acing them.

subject: dumbfounded
author: Mad Wookiee11
body:
I was so shocked by my crash that it took me a few seconds to even realize it had happened. 😕 I was already planning where I would go next and I guess I got ahead of myself.  I've found that for me stunt runs are easier in reverse.  My 6.6 mil stunt run was done in the van in reverse except for a couple times where I got stuck and had to boost.  but in reverse, you basically have all the time in the world to get your points and you don't have to go very fast, either.

Utinam logica falsa tuam philosophiam totam suffodiant!
